test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: According to the fiscal roadmap outlined by the Sixteenth Finance Commission (FC-16), the Centre should bring down its fiscal deficit to what percentage of the GDP by 2030-31?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3.5%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) report includes a comprehensive fiscal roadmap for both the Union and State governments for the 2026-31 period.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Commission recommended that the Central Government reduce its fiscal deficit to 3.5% of the GDP by the end of the recommendation period (2030-31).**
 
• For the State governments, the Commission recommended a strictly maintained annual fiscal deficit limit of 3% of their GSDP.
 
• It also emphasized the discontinuation of off-budget borrowings for states, requiring all such borrowings to be brought onto the official budget.
 
• The Commission projects a decline in combined debt (Centre and States) from 77.3% in 2026-27 to 73.1% of GDP by 2030-31.
 
• Fiscal Targets (FC-16)__
 __
 
• Centre Fiscal Deficit Target - 3.5% of GDP (by 2030-31)
 
• State Fiscal Deficit Limit - 3% of GSDP
 
• Combined Debt Projection - 73.1% of GDP (by 2030-31)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Fiscal Deficit__

 __
 
• The difference between the government's total expenditure and its total receipts (excluding borrowings). It indicates the total borrowing requirements of the government.
 
 
 
• Off-budget Borrowings__
 __
 
• Loans taken by government entities or PSUs where the principal and interest are repaid by the government through its budget, but the debt does not show up in the fiscal deficit calculation.
 
 
 
• GSDP (Gross State Domestic Product)__
 __
 
• The sum total of value added by all resident producer units within the state during a specific period.
 
 
 
• FRBM Act__
 
 
• The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act aims to ensure institutionalize financial discipline and reduce India's fiscal deficit.
